description: Our idea with AstroDeepSpace is to create a software that uses AI to monitor astronauts' health during space missions. We want it to collect and analyze biometric data, detect unusual changes, and provide useful information, alerts, and recommendations about the astronaut's health. We also want to include cybersecurity to encrypt and protect their personal and medical data. We're looking for people interested in AI, programming, cybersecurity, and space exploration.
